content: 1. Lenacapavir has the potential to increase the levels or effects of CYP3A4 substrates by altering hepatic and intestinal enzyme metabolism. This may elevate the risk of adverse reactions associated with these substrates. Close monitoring is recommended. 2. Lenacapavir can increase the levels or effects of ospemifene by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. 3. Lenacapavir may elevate the levels of CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir, potentially increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Close monitoring is advised. 4. Oxcarbazepine decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative anticonvulsants, as the combination is not recommended. 5. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of oxycodone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary to ensure therapeutic safety. 6. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of paclitaxel by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely, as the risk of adverse reactions may increase for CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months of the last lenacapavir dose. 7. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of paclitaxel protein-bound formulations via CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are required. 8. Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of pacritinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 9. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of palbociclib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of palovarotene by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. If unavoidable, reduce the palovarotene dose by 50% and monitor closely. 11. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of panobinostat by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. If unavoidable, reduce the pemigatinib dose and resume the original dose after discontinuing the inhibitor for 3-5 half-lives. 14.
